title: General tab not working; Update Available button doesn't do anything
summary: The attached report identifies the General-page style mismatch already fixed by merged PR #49801.
next_action: Point to #49801 and confirm both entry points after a direct current-release upgrade.

judgment.rationale: The report's exact control/target-type exception matches merged #49801, and the affected release source has the pre-fix assignment. Existing-fix coverage is substantially stronger than a new hypothesis.
evidence: Reporter uses 0.101.2211, GitHub user installation, Windows 11 Enterprise 25H2, English; General navigation and Update Available do nothing.
The supplied Settings log for 2026-10-27 records XamlParseException during GeneralPage.InitializeComponent: a TextBlock-targeted Style cannot apply to IsEnabledTextBlock.
The matching fix #49801 merged on 2026-08-10; both current main and v0.102.3001 use SecondaryIsEnabledTextBlockStyle for GeneralPage_UpdateChannelDescription.
Read the complete issue and selectively inspected Settings logs in the attached report; multiple dated logs contain the same exception, including the report-day log.

Compared the reported v0.101.2211.0 XAML, which assigns SecondaryTextStyle, to the corrected source: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/v0.101.2211.0/src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/SettingsXAML/Views/GeneralPage.xaml#L105-L115
Read #49801 and its exact one-line patch: replace SecondaryTextStyle with SecondaryIsEnabledTextBlockStyle on GeneralPage_UpdateChannelDescription: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/49801

Verified the corrected assignment is present in the current released source: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/v0.102.3001/src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/SettingsXAML/Views/GeneralPage.xaml#L90-L100
judgment.recommended_action: Point to #49801 and confirm both entry points after a direct current-release upgrade.

comment.body:
Thanks for the complete reproduction steps and attached report. The Settings log identifies a specific XAML error: a TextBlock style is being applied to IsEnabledTextBlock while General opens. That exact error was fixed in #49801, and the correction is present in the current release.

Could you install the current official release directly from https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/releases/latest (rather than the non-working in-app button), restart PowerToys, and confirm whether General and Update Available now open? This will distinguish the already-fixed 0.101.2211 problem from a separate current-build failure; no repeat of the existing report or system details is needed.

fix_assessment.rationale: Merged #49801 corrects the exact incompatible style named in the supplied report, and the corrected assignment is in v0.102.3001. Runtime resolution on this reporter's installation remains to be confirmed.
